bootstrap.scope: Exploratory descriptive uncertainty conditional on these selected queries.
bootstrap.sampling_assumption: Query-level exchangeability is not established by the purposive or topic-related samples.

design_limitations: Six staged configurations are not a complete factorial design.
No RRF+rewrite without rerank; rewrite-by-rerank interaction cannot be estimated.
No lexical+rerank or dense+rerank controls; reranker benefit cannot be separated across recall branches.
No chunk-size, candidate-limit, fusion-weight, RRF-k, rerank-pool or vector-coverage sweep.
No passage-vs-document or deduplicated-qrels comparison; no generation, faithfulness or token-cost measurement.
Chinese and English use different questions/topics; language-group differences are not causal language effects.
Historical latency has fixed stage order, shared CPU and unequal warmup/session conditions; no causal speedup claim.
Intervals do not repair small purposive samples, incomplete judgments, model selection on the same set or implementation drift.

protocol.warmup_restart_policy: Interrupted stages resume measured checkpoints after another complete warmup pass. Actual and additional warmup counts are recorded separately for each stage.
protocol.warmup_failure_definition: Only raised warmup exceptions are counted. Provider warnings returned during warmup are not retained, so zero warmup_failures does not establish warning-free warmup.

artifact_io.writer_policy: One active driver per output directory; a local file lock prevents concurrent driver writers.
artifact_io.resumed_output_storage: Checkpoint continuation was relocated to a nonsynchronized local directory exposed by a junction; earlier completed results were preserved.

stage_design.hybrid: Sum of positive branch scores normalized by each branch maximum; equal branch contributions.
stage_design.rrf: Replaces score-normalized fusion with the sum of 1/(60+rank) over keyword and vector branch ranks.
stage_design.rerank: RRF followed by cross-encoder scoring of up to 50 distinct-document representative passages.
stage_design.rewrite: Original query plus up to two rule expansions, each sent through keyword and vector recall; all lists use RRF and the cross-encoder scores using the original query.

protocol.execution_environment: Local CPU shared with unrelated independent Python workloads; neither CPU load nor task isolation was controlled.
protocol.latency_percentile: p50 median; p95 nearest rank ceil(0.95*N).
protocol.latency_setup_scope: Per-query timing includes work and lazy initialization executed inside the retrieval timer. Setup performed before that timer, such as cross-encoder provider construction, is excluded. Lazy E5/runtime initialization can contribute to the first warmup query; measured aggregates follow warmup.
protocol.lexical_ranking: PostgreSQL ts_rank term-frequency ranking, not ts_rank_cd cover density or BM25
protocol.lexical_query_preprocessing: Standard stop-word removal; Chinese bigrams suppress broad single-character OR terms; at most 96 OR terms.
protocol.postgres_execution: Late text materialization after candidate cut; a savepoint around each warmup and measured query prevents SQL exceptions poisoning later queries.

ranking_metrics.recall: Fraction of positive qrel document IDs present in the first ten unique IDs.
ranking_metrics.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first grade-positive document in the first ten.
ranking_metrics.ndcg: Graded gain 2^relevance-1 with log2(rank+1) discount, normalized by ideal qrels ordering.

original_limitations: Purposive answer-known sample; no independent held-out evaluation or statistical significance claim.
Unjudged documents are treated as irrelevant for these diagnostics; legitimate unjudged evidence can be penalized.
Metrics are document-ID-level; identical full-body copies have identical qrels but count separately in recall denominators.
Two negative cases use impossible filters; no semantic answerability or generation accuracy is measured.
Vector coverage is partial. Dense baseline searches the existing vector subset, not every passage.
The pinned MiniLM cross-encoder is trained on English MS MARCO; this is not a multilingual reranker evaluation.
Chinese and English groups contain different topics, so their score difference is not a controlled language-effect estimate.
Rewrite uses local deterministic bilingual rules; it is not an LLM query-rewrite experiment.
Benchmarks measure raw staged retrieval rankings; Dashboard source-weight and recency overlays require separate HTTP/MCP consistency checks.

Latency is local CPU elapsed retrieval time including per-query embeddings/rewrite/rerank and any lazy initialization inside the query timer. Setup outside that timer, such as cross-encoder provider construction, is excluded. No response generation or network transport is measured.
Lazy E5 or runtime initialization can be included in the first warmup query. Measured aggregates follow warmup; first-query timing does not isolate one initialization component.
First-query timing records the first warmup query and is not a full service cold-start measurement.
Three repeated runs estimate local timing variability, not 60 independent relevance questions.
Stages run in fixed sequence on a shared local CPU, so cache and workload differences prevent a causal speedup claim.

Unrelated independent Python workloads were running on the same machine and were preserved. CPU contention was not isolated or held constant; stage latency differences are observational, not causal performance improvements.
Interrupted model stages can resume measured cases after an extra warmup. Their latency observations may span multiple process sessions; the recorded session and warmup counts must be considered.
Warmup failure counters record raised exceptions only. Warmup provider warnings were not collected; zero exceptions must not be presented as zero warmup degradation.

The first four stages were freshly measured on 2026-10-13 before checkpoint fingerprints were added. Their complete results were explicitly reused after snapshot, question, label and arithmetic revalidation; no historical source hash is fabricated.
Using this diagnostic to select a profile does not establish independent generalization quality.
